sources.title: [2512.09841] ChronusOmni: Improving Time Awareness of Omni Large ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose ChronusOmni, an omni large language model designed to enhance temporal awareness for both explicit and implicit audiovisual temporal grounding. First, we interleave text-based timestamp tokens with visual and audio representations at each time unit, enabling unified temporal modeling across modalities.
